tagline: Leading global financial services company providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted ROE target of 15-17%, reflecting MetLife's commitment to generating attractive shareholder returns while maintaining a global expansion strategy and all-weather performance

kpis.name: Adjusted Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Annualized return on adjusted equity capital, excluding notable items
kpis.description: MetLife is committed to maintaining adjusted return on equity between 15-17%, excluding notable items, reflecting its objective to generate attractive returns for shareholders
kpis.signal: Profitability target maintained for 2026 and beyond

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cumulative free cash flow over the 2025-2029 period
kpis.description: MetLife projects to generate approximately $25 billion in cumulative free cash flow during the 2025-2029 period, supporting its shareholder return strategy
kpis.signal: Projection of $25 billion in FCF over 5 years, 2025-2029

kpis.name: Direct Expense Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of direct expenses to revenue, excluding notable items
kpis.description: MetLife targets a direct expense ratio of 12.1% for 2026 and 11.3% for 2029, excluding notable items, demonstrating its commitment to expense discipline and operational efficiency
kpis.signal: 2026 target of 12.1% and long-term objective of 11.3% by 2029

kpis.name: Holding Company Cash
kpis.explanation: Liquidity and liquid assets available at the holding company level
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, MetLife had $3.6 billion in cash and liquid assets at the holding company level, consistent with its operational target of $3.0 to $4.0 billion
kpis.signal: Cash within the target band of $3.0-$4.0 billion

kpis.name: Shareholder Distributions
kpis.explanation: Total amount returned to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases
kpis.description: MetLife returned approximately $4.4 billion to shareholders in 2025 through dividends and share repurchases, demonstrating its commitment to creating shareholder value

kpis.name: FCF to Adjusted Earnings Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of free cash flow conversion to adjusted earnings, excluding notable items, on a two-year basis
kpis.description: MetLife is committed to maintaining an average two-year ratio of free cash flow to adjusted earnings between 65-75%, excluding notable items, reflecting the quality and sustainability of its earnings
kpis.signal: Conversion of 65-75% of adjusted earnings to free cash flow on a 2-year basis

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $745.17 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $20.18 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Revenue of $77.084 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $3.379 billion in the latest year.

risks.title: Economic and Capital Markets Risks
risks.score_rationale: Market factors including interest rates, credit spreads, declining equity and bond markets, derivative prices, real estate conditions, foreign exchange rates, consumer and government spending can reduce revenue growth, investment opportunities and returns (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: Interest rates are a key driver of MetLife's results, affecting guaranteed spread margins, investment returns, reinvestments, liability reserves and derivative cash flows (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Inflation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Inflation can increase premiums in group insurance businesses, raise labor expenses, impact financial markets, and require adjustments to credit rates on policies (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit and Counterparty Risks
risks.score_rationale: Defaults by counterparties, failures of financial institutions and variations in credit spreads could negatively impact investments and derivatives (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Equity Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in equity markets affect the value of assets under management in the asset management business and impact returns on certain insurance products (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Liquidity and Funding Risks
risks.score_rationale: Difficulties accessing financing or events affecting market liquidity could compromise MetLife's ability to meet its obligations and financial covenants (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: MetLife operates in many countries; fluctuations in foreign exchange rates could affect the value of assets under management, foreign investments and converted revenues (default score, to be refined)
